# R package dependencies for scrna-seurat recipe
# Install before running the pipeline

# Core
# install.packages(c("Seurat", "dplyr", "patchwork", "ggplot2", "tibble", "Matrix", "remotes"))

Seurat        # >= 4.0, single-cell analysis framework
dplyr         # data manipulation
patchwork     # combining ggplot2 panels
ggplot2       # visualisation
tibble        # data frame utilities
Matrix        # sparse matrix support

# Doublet detection
# remotes::install_github("chris-mcginnis-ucsf/DoubletFinder")
DoubletFinder

# Normalisation
# SCTransform is included in Seurat >= 4.0

# Automated cell annotation (Bioconductor)
# BiocManager::install(c("SingleR", "celldex"))
SingleR
celldex

# Multi-sample integration
# install.packages("harmony")
harmony

# Pseudobulk DE
# BiocManager::install("DESeq2")
DESeq2

# Trajectory inference
# remotes::install_github("cole-trapnell-lab/monocle3")
# remotes::install_github("satijalab/seurat-wrappers")
monocle3
SeuratWrappers

# Cell-cell communication
# remotes::install_github("jinworks/CellChat")
CellChat

# Pathway enrichment
# install.packages("enrichR")
enrichR

# ExperimentHub / SCE loading (Bioconductor)
# BiocManager::install(c("ExperimentHub", "SingleCellExperiment"))
ExperimentHub
SingleCellExperiment

# Optional: spatstat (required by some older versions of DoubletFinder)
# install.packages("spatstat.core")
